description: Images from a local ComfyUI server using the bundled SD 1.5 text-to-image API workflow; add your own exported workflows for video, music or 3D.
verification: unverified example: adapter covered by tests against a fake ComfyUI API, not a live server

config.notes: Edit ckpt_name in the workflow to a checkpoint you installed and add output_rights for its licence. For video, export e.g. a Wan or LTX-Video workflow with Save (API) and bind duration with {"transform": "frames", "frame_multiple": 4, "frame_offset": 1}.
